description: This file defines the DataGroupAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing RESTful API endpoints related to data groups. It includes methods for retrieving all data group permissions and placeholders for create and delete operations, which are not yet implemented.

classes.name: DataGroupAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing data groups within the OrangeHRM system, supporting retrieval of data permissions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all data group permission collections for the current user role.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Attempts to handle creation of data groups but is currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'create' method (not implemented).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Attempts to handle deletion of data groups but is currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method (not implemented).
